title: 27-5 KING Beds Downtown- The Music City Collection
description:
Experience Nashville in this new modern home with 5 bedrooms, 3.5 baths, 7 beds, Bonus Room, and Rooftop. You'll be just 5 minutes away from Broadway and Nashville's Downtown core, where you'll discover all the best attractions in Music City! This brand-new home has it all and is beautifully decorated with designer finishes. You'll enjoy a beautiful large open floor plan living and dining space, and a complete kitchen. The rooftop includes a FIREPLACE! STRP#2021011741

The space
Bed Layout: Downstairs Two Bedrooms with King Beds, Primary Bedroom upstairs with  King Bed and ensuite bath, Two additional Upstairs Bedrooms with King Beds,  Sleeper Sectional in the bonus room and  Queen Sleeper Sofa in Downstairs Living Room.

Guest access
Guests have access to the entire private home and attached two car garage.  There is a smart lock with unique code for each stay, as well as security system and entry cameras.
